entries.target_title: Letter to The Communist Correspondence Committee, October 23, 1846
entries.bibliography: The opening extract in the French compilation Le parti de classe is identified by its first note as an Engels letter of 23 October 1846. The English MECW vol. 38 pp. 81–86 transcription identifies the recipient as the Communist Correspondence Committee in Brussels; the opening, Proudhon discussion and numbered definition correspond. The French compilation also includes material from later letters: do not claim full-document parallelism or apply this target to other excerpts. The authors field matches the compilation metadata, not the authorship of the English letter. Exact bilingual passage and attribution must be reviewed independently.
entries.rights_note: Documentary lead only; source and target spans, edition, attribution and rights require separate review.
